args.lesson: Gumroad Discover cannot supply a first buyer. The official help page says eligibility needs USD 100 of genuine sales plus about 3 weeks of risk review, and each product also needs one prior sale. A Gumroad account gives collection only, not discovery. What worked: Gumroad help pages are Inertia apps, so the article text sits in the data-page JSON. Plain tag stripping gave 40 chars; parsing data-page gave the full text in one EXEC. Next time, check marketplace listing gates before treating a platform as an acquisition channel. Any payment route still needs direct acquisition from pages we already control.
